title: Rectangular section
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. In this coordinate system, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. The first loop of this sketch consists of four lines: the first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0285, 0.0); the second line starts at (0.0285, 0.0) and ends at (0.0285, 0.0205); the third line starts at (0.0285, 0.0205) and ends at (0.0, 0.0205); the fourth line starts at (0.0, 0.0205) and returns to the origin. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.0285. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by applying a rotation with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction, ensuring no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. Perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The final dimensions of the rectangular section are 0.028452200303490133 units in length, 0.020485584218512896 units in width, and 0.7499999999999999 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0285, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0285, 0.0205) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0205) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a 3D object
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Create a rounded-rectangle cross-section bar
# Bounding box: X 0.0285, Y 0.0205, Z 0.7500
# Corner radius ~0.00125 (inferred from rounded corners in the top view)

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .rect(0.0285, 0.0205)
    .extrude(0.75)
    .edges("|Z")
    .fillet(0.00125)
)
